No ruler strip: the page dates only Ivan IV (1547-1584), Aleksey (1645-1676) and Peter I (1682-1721)

Steppe-frontier contacts with the Kalmyk Khanate, Small Horde, Kazakh Khanate and Dzungar Khanate (neighbours in the seed) have no event; the Sloboda Ukraine split from the Tsardom (1650) is not written on this side

Chukotka (49 percent) and a Kamchatka sliver (15 percent) lie inside every Cliopatria shape from 1653 though the Siberia page dates Kamchatka to 1697-1698 and the final annexation of Chukotka to 1778; kept as soft claims
Cossack Hetmanate vassal_start (1654) has no end and no counterpart dossier; Kiev, Zaporizhzhia and the Left Bank statuses after 1667 need the Hetmanate dossier

The Don Host's land (Rostov oblast, Don-Volga steppe) is inside no shape from 1643 to 1720: Cliopatria's Don row stops 1641 and no Tsardom shape contains it. The Host continued as an autonomous formation under the Moscow State (autonomy 1671-1786) to 1918; needs a continuation dossier or vassal events with dated sources
The 1636 enlargement (+61.7 k km2), the early extent, the founding of the Host and the capital dates before the 1640s are on no page opened
Years of the Right-bank and Belarusian captures, the Bila Tserkva and Solonytsia battles, and any territory held as a state are not on the two pages (two events at confidence 1)

problems: Dossiers exist at history/polities/{tsardom-of-russia,don-cossacks,nalyvaiko-uprising}.json and each validates with 0 errors. The Tsardom has 4 warnings (kingdom-of-livonia and cossack-hetmanate counterparts have no dossier; the 1654 vassal_start has no end because the relation outlasts the Tsardom) and 20 gazetteer warnings for 8 real place names.

Cliopatria's Don Cossacks row ends 1641 and no Tsardom shape 1642-1720 contains the Don land (0 cells of Rostov oblast): a visible hole of about 100-130 k km2 for ~80 years; the don-cossacks dossier ends 1642 with a confidence-1 dissolve and the hole is recorded in both notes.

Mismatches with other groups to settle: Russian Empire dossier dates the Baltic gain 1721 while the Tsardom dossier has the conquests in 1710 (Nystad as contest_end); Ottoman dossier dates Azov's return 1713 while the Tsardom has the Pruth treaty (July 1711); the Qasim Khanate row stops 1551 though the khanate ended 1681.

Cliopatria shapes run one to five years behind the pages for most Siberian and Baltic steps; 15 Tsardom verdicts are adjust and 7 new keyframes (1558, 1590, 1617, 1703, 1710, 1711, 1714) were added. Nalyvaiko's shape ends 1599 but the pages end the rising in July 1596; both shapes are adjust.

Several page summaries came back with conflicting dates, which the event notes record (Narva and Dorpat months, Smolensk 2 or 13 June 1611, Kremlin 6-7 November 1612, Pruth treaty 21 or 22 July, Magnus 1570 or 1576). WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, so quotes in notes are the summary's quotations of the page, closely paraphrased where marked.

sources_total 23 counts the sources[] of each dossier; 21 distinct pages were opened (the Don Cossacks and Azov pages are listed in both the Tsardom's and the Don's sources).
